---
title: "Socialism: Corporatism by Another Name"
subtitle: "What would happen if government took over the largest companies?"
author: "David Price"
date: "2026-08-25"
categories: [analysis, technology, environment]
---

One idea being discussed is a "hostile" takeover of a number of corporations by the American government. In this case, the national government. Why you might ask? Because they want to replace the corporate boards to put in place their preferences. Honestly, the why doesn't matter as much as the how and the consequences.

The value of the 500 largest companies registered in America fluxuates. Combining the number of publically traded shares with the current trade value of those shares gives you roughly $75 trillion. Who owns these shares: everyone. This is not the Guild age where single individuals own companies. The era of Carnigie, Morgan, and Rockafellar
